process.label: Process
process.heading: How TokenWalla Works
process.sub: From browsing doctors to walking in on time — the entire process takes under 2 minutes.

steps.title: Find a Doctor
steps.desc: Browse by specialization, city, or hospital. See real-time availability and time slots.

steps.title: Pick a Slot
steps.desc: Choose your preferred date and time. Confirm your appointment in under 60 seconds.

steps.title: Pay Securely
steps.desc: Pay ₹15 via UPI, cards or wallets. Your token and queue position are confirmed instantly.

steps.title: Walk In on Time
steps.desc: Arrive when your number is called. Track live position from anywhere.
